duration.$description: How long a change takes, named by its length in milliseconds, so 150 is 150ms. 0 is no time at all, for a change that should happen at once.

easing.$description: The shape of a change over its time, as the two control points of a cubic Bézier curve: x1, y1, x2, y2.

standard.$description: Starts quickly and settles gently, for something that stays on screen as it changes.

decelerate.$description: Arrives at full speed and slows to a stop.

accelerate.$description: Starts slowly and speeds up until it is gone.
